rationalize-hole.alt: The graph of y = (square root of x minus 2) divided by (x minus 4) for x from 0 to 12: it starts at (0, 0.5), falls slowly, and has an open circle at (4, 1/4). A panel shows the algebra: multiplying by the conjugate gives 1 over (square root of x plus 2), which is 1/4 at x = 4.
